blocks.text:
Arrival at Rio de Janeiro airport, where a driver meets you for the transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to enjoy your first impressions of the Marvellous City: feel its exciting life, or relax among the palm trees with a coconut water to the sound of samba. Whatever you choose, you will find it easily in Rio!

The blue ocean calls you to the beach: Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon are famous for their black-and-white mosaic promenades, where from early morning until late at night people play football and volleyball on the golden sand. Open-air cafés serve coconut water and freshly squeezed juices, and local musicians often play on the beach. Optional: a beaches and lagoon bike tour (see Optional excursions).
Copacabana’s mosaic promenade and palm-lined beach in golden light, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

blocks.text:
After breakfast, a guided excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, the islands in the ocean, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then drive to the old centre of Rio to admire its churches, monasteries, cathedral and colonial-style buildings; your guide then takes you to lunch to enjoy delicious local dishes.

Afterwards, head to the world-famous statue of Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado. A specially designed train climbs from the foot of the mountain through the Tijuca rainforest, where you may spot toucans, monkeys and other tropical wildlife. At the summit, 710 metres above sea level, stands the iconic 38-metre statue, with a stunning panorama of the city, so high up that you seem to fly with the birds. Optional: a helicopter flight over Rio.
